<!-- Add Description Below -->

The scope of this guideline is to provide recommendations for studies
reporting key health and justice outcomes for discharged forensic patients
and people released from prison settings returning to the community.
Specifically, the guideline aims to provide recommendations for
standardising the way in which post discharge and release community
outcomes, including reoffending, readmissions and mortality, are defined,
measured, recorded, analysed, and reported. A standardised approach will
improve comparability between studies, settings, and samples, allowing
future meta-analytic syntheses.
